report.summary: Successfully implemented dependency-free Node.js ESM TODO CLI at ./cli.mjs. All 6 acceptance tests pass. The CLI correctly handles add, list, and complete commands with proper JSON output, ID management, title preservation, error handling, and storage isolation.
evidence: All 6 acceptance tests pass: new storage lists empty array, adds persist literal titles with stable increasing IDs, completion is repeatable and preserves state, invalid input never creates storage, invalid input preserves storage bytes and next ID, TODO_FILE isolates independent stores

Implementation verified: cli.mjs created with 123 lines, proper ESM imports from 'fs', correct argument parsing, ID validation with regex /^[1-9]\d*$/, whitespace-only title rejection, storage isolation via TODO_FILE env var
Independent verification confirms: empty title rejected with exit code 1, invalid ID 'abc' rejected with exit code 1, unknown command rejected with exit code 1
